every_position_composed.reason: Site 1 keeps the 3D scene framed cleanly beside pinned text cards across frames 1–9, whereas Site 2 has text cards blocking the 3D model in frames 2–3 and leaves empty or obscured backgrounds in frames 6 and 8–9.

overall.reason: Site 1 better fulfills the request for a smooth, visual scroll experience by keeping every scroll step cleanly composed and translating Straitjacket's workflow into a single, legible 3D machine.
